svg.title: 02 Q-Day
svg.desc: Chapter 2. A large enough quantum computer could one day read it. Shor's algorithm factors RSA moduli and solves the discrete logarithms behind elliptic curves in polynomial time. The 2048-bit modulus splits into its factors p and q, and the lock opens.

g.text: Shor's algorithm factors RSA moduli and solves the
discrete logarithms behind elliptic curves in polynomial
